edition 7;
import std.list;
import std.result;

fn csv_parse_line[&h, &r](heap: &!h Heap, line: &r [byte]) -> [heap] result.Result[list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]], int] {
    var fields: list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]] = list.List::Empty;
    var i = 0;
    var n = len(line);
    var start = 0;
    var in_quotes = false;
    var field_has_content = false;
    var field_is_quoted = false;
    var field_start = 0;

    while i < n {
        let c = int_of(line[i]);
        if in_quotes {
            if c == 34 {
                if i + 1 < n && int_of(line[i + 1]) == 34 {
                    i = i + 2;
                    continue;
                } else {
                    in_quotes = false;
                    i = i + 1;
                    if i < n && int_of(line[i]) != 44 {
                        return result.Result::Err(1);
                    }
                    let end = i;
                    let len = end - field_start;
                    let b = box_slice(heap, len, byte_of(0));
                    borrow mut b as &!w in {
                        let dest = contents(w);
                        var j = 0;
                        while j < len {
                            dest[j] = line[field_start + j];
                            j = j + 1;
                        }
                    }
                    let wrapped = box(heap, b);
                    fields = list.push(heap, fields, wrapped);
                    field_has_content = false;
                    field_is_quoted = false;
                    if i < n {
                        i = i + 1;
                        field_start = i;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
                continue;
            }
        } else {
            if c == 34 {
                if i == field_start {
                    in_quotes = true;
                    field_is_quoted = true;
                    i = i + 1;
                    continue;
                } else {
                    return result.Result::Err(2);
                }
            } else if c == 10 || c == 13 {
                return result.Result::Err(3);
            } else if c == 44 {
                let end = i;
                let len = end - field_start;
                let b = box_slice(heap, len, byte_of(0));
                borrow mut b as &!w in {
                    let dest = contents(w);
                    var j = 0;
                    while j < len {
                        dest[j] = line[field_start + j];
                        j = j + 1;
                    }
                }
                let wrapped = box(heap, b);
                fields = list.push(heap, fields, wrapped);
                i = i + 1;
                field_start = i;
                continue;
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
                continue;
            }
        }
    }

    if in_quotes {
        return result.Result::Err(4);
    }

    let end = n;
    let len = end - field_start;
    let b = box_slice(heap, len, byte_of(0));
    borrow mut b as &!w in {
        let dest = contents(w);
        var j = 0;
        while j < len {
            dest[j] = line[field_start + j];
            j = j + 1;
        }
    }
    let wrapped = box(heap, b);
    fields = list.push(heap, fields, wrapped);

    return result.Result::Ok(fields);
}

fn main(world: World) -> [] int {
    let Split { io, ffi, fs, heap, args, net, clock, signals, exec } = split(world);
    release(ffi); release(fs); release(args); release(io); release(net); release(clock); release(signals); release(exec);
    release(heap);
    return 0;
}

import std.list;
import std.result;

fn csv_parse_line[&h, &r](heap: &!h Heap, line: &r [byte]) -> [heap] result.Result[list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]], int] {
    var fields: list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]] = list.List::Empty;
    var i = 0;
    var n = len(line);
    var field_start = 0;
    var in_quotes = false;
    var done = false;

    while i < n && !done {
        let c = int_of(line[i]);
        if in_quotes {
            if c == 34 {
                if i + 1 < n && int_of(line[i + 1]) == 34 {
                    i = i + 2;
                 } else {
                    in_quotes = false;
                    i = i + 1;

                        var j = 0;
                        while j < len(fields) {
                            match fields {
                                list.List::Empty => {
                                    fields = list.List::Empty;
                                }
                                list.List::Cons(head, rest) => {
                                    unbox_slice(heap, unbox(heap, head));
                                    fields = unbox(heap, rest);

                        }

                 }
             } else if c == 10 || c == 13 {

                            fields = list.List::Empty;

                            fields = unbox(heap, rest);
                        }

edition 7;
import std.list;
import std.result;

fn quoted_end[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    let n = len(line);
    var i = start + 1;
    var closed = 0 - 1;
    while i < n && closed < 0 {
        if int_of(line[i]) == '"' {
            if i + 1 < n && int_of(line[i + 1]) == '"' {
                i = i + 2;
            } else {
                closed = i;
            }
        } else {
            i = i + 1;
        }
    }
    if closed < 0 {
        return result.Result::Err(2);
    }
    let after = closed + 1;
    if after < n && int_of(line[after]) != ',' {
        return result.Result::Err(3);
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(after);
}

fn plain_end[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    let n = len(line);
    var i = start;
    var bad = 0;
    while i < n && int_of(line[i]) != ',' && bad == 0 {
        let c = int_of(line[i]);
        if c == '"' {
            bad = 1;
        } else if c == '\r' || c == '\n' {
            bad = 4;
        } else {
            i = i + 1;
        }
    }
    if bad != 0 {
        return result.Result::Err(bad);
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(i);
}

fn field_end[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    if start < len(line) && int_of(line[start]) == '"' {
        return quoted_end(line, start);
    }
    return plain_end(line, start);
}

fn count_fields[&r](line: &r [byte]) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    let n = len(line);
    var start = 0;
    var count = 0;
    var err = 0;
    var more = 1;
    while more == 1 && err == 0 {
        match field_end(line, start) {
            result.Result::Ok(e) => {
                count = count + 1;
                if e < n {
                    start = e + 1;
                } else {
                    more = 0;
                }
            }
            result.Result::Err(c) => {
                err = c;
            }
        }
    }
    if err != 0 {
        return result.Result::Err(err);
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(count);
}

fn decoded_len[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int, end: int) -> [] int {
    if start < end && int_of(line[start]) == '"' {
        var i = start + 1;
        var k = 0;
        while i < end - 1 {
            if int_of(line[i]) == '"' {
                i = i + 2;
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
            }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return k;
    }
    return end - start;
}

fn copy_field[&r, &w](line: &r [byte], start: int, end: int, dst: &!w [byte]) -> [] int {
    if start < end && int_of(line[start]) == '"' {
        var i = start + 1;
        var k = 0;
        while i < end - 1 {
            dst[k] = line[i];
            if int_of(line[i]) == '"' {
                i = i + 2;
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
            }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    var j = start;
    while j < end {
        dst[j - start] = line[j];
        j = j + 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

fn csv_parse_line[&h, &r](heap: &!h Heap, line: &r [byte]) -> [heap] result.Result[list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]], int] {
    match count_fields(line) {
        result.Result::Err(c) => {
            return result.Result::Err(c);
        }
        result.Result::Ok(_) => {
        }
    }
    let n = len(line);
    var fields = list.empty(heap);
    var start = 0;
    var more = 1;
    while more == 1 {
        match field_end(line, start) {
            result.Result::Ok(e) => {
                let k = decoded_len(line, start, e);
                let bytes = box_slice(heap, k, byte_of(0));
                borrow mut bytes as &!w in {
                    let s = contents(w);
                    copy_field(line, start, e, s);
                }
                let field = box(heap, bytes);
                fields = list.push(heap, fields, field);
                if e < n {
                    start = e + 1;
                } else {
                    more = 0;
                }
            }
            result.Result::Err(_) => {
                more = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(fields);
}

    return result.Result::Ok(after);
}

fn plain_end[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    let n = len(line);
    var i = start;
    var bad = 0;
    while i < n && int_of(line[i]) != ',' && bad == 0 {
        let c = int_of(line[i]);
        if c == '"' {
            bad = 1;
        } else if c == '\r' || c == '\n' {
            bad = 4;
        } else {
            i = i + 1;
        }
    }
    if bad != 0 {
        return result.Result::Err(bad);
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(i);
}

fn field_end[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    if start < len(line) && int_of(line[start]) == '"' {
        return quoted_end(line, start);
    }
    return plain_end(line, start);
}

fn count_fields[&r](line: &r [byte]) -> [] result.Result[int, int] {
    let n = len(line);
    var start = 0;
    var count = 0;
    var err = 0;
    var more = 1;
    while more == 1 && err == 0 {
        match field_end(line, start) {
            result.Result::Ok(e) => {
                count = count + 1;
                if e < n {
                    start = e + 1;
                } else {
                    more = 0;
                }
            }
            result.Result::Err(c) => {
                err = c;
            }
        }
    }
    if err != 0 {
        return result.Result::Err(err);
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(count);
}

fn decoded_len[&r](line: &r [byte], start: int, end: int) -> [] int {
    if start < end && int_of(line[start]) == '"' {
        var i = start + 1;
        var k = 0;
        while i < end - 1 {
            if int_of(line[i]) == '"' {
                i = i + 2;
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
            }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return k;
    }
    return end - start;
}

fn copy_field[&r, &w](line: &r [byte], start: int, end: int, dst: &!w [byte]) -> [] int {
    if start < end && int_of(line[start]) == '"' {
        var i = start + 1;
        var k = 0;
        while i < end - 1 {
            dst[k] = line[i];
            if int_of(line[i]) == '"' {
                i = i + 2;
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
            }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    var j = start;
    while j < end {
        dst[j - start] = line[j];
        j = j + 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

fn csv_parse_line[&h, &r](heap: &!h Heap, line: &r [byte]) -> [heap] result.Result[list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]], int] {
    match count_fields(line) {
        result.Result::Err(c) => {
            return result.Result::Err(c);
        }
        result.Result::Ok(_) => {
        }
    }
    let n = len(line);
    var fields = list.empty(heap);
    var start = 0;
    var more = 1;
    while more == 1 {
        match field_end(line, start) {
            result.Result::Ok(e) => {
                let k = decoded_len(line, start, e);
                let bytes = box_slice(heap, k, byte_of(0));
                borrow mut bytes as &!w in {
                    let s = contents(w);
                    copy_field(line, start, e, s);
                }
                let field = box(heap, bytes);
                fields = list.push(heap, fields, field);
                if e < n {
                    start = e + 1;
                } else {
                    more = 0;
                }
            }
            result.Result::Err(_) => {
                more = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(fields);
}

fn needs_quote[&r](s: &r [byte]) -> [] bool {
    var i = 0;
    var q = false;
    while i < len(s) && !q {
        let c = int_of(s[i]);
        if c == 44 || c == 34 || c == 13 || c == 10 {
            q = true;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return q;
}

fn field_len[&r](s: &r [byte]) -> [] int {
    if !needs_quote(s) {
        return len(s);
    }
    var n = 2;
    var i = 0;
    while i < len(s) {
        if int_of(s[i]) == 34 {
            n = n + 2;
        } else {
            n = n + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return n;
}

fn put_field[&r, &d](s: &r [byte], dst: &!d [byte], at: int) -> [] int {
    var p = at;
    let q = needs_quote(s);
    if q {
        dst[p] = byte_of(34);
        p = p + 1;
    }
    var i = 0;
    while i < len(s) {
        let c = int_of(s[i]);
        dst[p] = s[i];
        p = p + 1;
        if q && c == 34 {
            dst[p] = byte_of(34);
            p = p + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    if q {
        dst[p] = byte_of(34);
        p = p + 1;
    }
    return p;
}

fn field_len_at[&l](fields: &l list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]], i: int) -> [] int {
    let s = contents(contents(list.at(fields, i)));
    return field_len(s);
}

fn put_at[&l, &d](fields: &l list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]], i: int, dst: &!d [byte], at: int) -> [] int {
    let s = contents(contents(list.at(fields, i)));
    return put_field(s, dst, at);
}

fn csv_format_line[&h, &l](heap: &!h Heap, fields: &l list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]]) -> [heap] Box[[byte]] {
    let n = list.len(fields);
    var total = 0;
    var i = 0;
    while i < n {
        total = total + field_len_at(fields, i);
        if i > 0 {
            total = total + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    let out = box_slice(heap, total, byte_of(0));
    borrow mut out as &!o in {
        let dst = contents(o);
        var p = 0;
        var j = 0;
        while j < n {
            if j > 0 {
                dst[p] = byte_of(44);
                p = p + 1;
            }
            p = put_at(fields, j, dst, p);
            j = j + 1;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

fn csv_format_line[&h, &l](heap: &!h Heap, fields: &l list.List[Box[Box[[byte]]]]) -> [heap] Box[[byte]] {

fn needs_quote[&r](s: &r [byte]) -> [] bool {

            q = true;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return q;

fn field_len[&r](s: &r [byte]) -> [] int {
    if !needs_quote(s) {
        return len(s);
    }
    var n = 2;
    var i = 0;
    while i < len(s) {
        if int_of(s[i]) == 34 {
            n = n + 2;
        } else {
            n = n + 1;

        i = i + 1;

    return put_field(s, dst, at);

// TASK. Write one function, named clamp, that takes three integers x, lo and hi and returns an integer:
//   - lo if x is less than lo,
//   - hi if x is greater than hi,
//   - x otherwise.
// It is a pure function (no effects). Do not change main.

fn clamp(x: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> [] int {
    if x < lo {
        return lo;
    }
    if x > hi {
        return hi;
    }
    return x;
}

fn main(world: World) -> [] int {

    release(ffi); release(fs); release(net); release(clock); release(signals); release(exec); release(args);
    release(io); release(heap);
    let a = clamp(5, 0, 3);
    let b = clamp(-2, 0, 3);
    let c = clamp(2, 0, 3);
    return 0;
}

edition 7;
import std.result;
import std.buffer;

fn duration_is_digit(c: int) -> [] bool {
    return c >= 48 && c <= 57;
}

fn duration_unit_rank(c: int) -> [] int {
    if c == 119 { return 0; }
    if c == 100 { return 1; }
    if c == 104 { return 2; }
    if c == 109 { return 3; }
    if c == 115 { return 4; }
    return 0 - 1;
}

fn duration_unit_seconds(rank: int) -> [] int {
    if rank == 0 { return 604800; }
    if rank == 1 { return 86400; }
    if rank == 2 { return 3600; }
    if rank == 3 { return 60; }
    return 1;
}

fn duration_parse[&r](s: &r [byte]) -> [] result.Result[int, &static [byte]] {
    if len(s) == 0 {
        return result.Result::Err("empty duration");
    }
    var i = 0;
    var total = 0;
    var last_rank = 0 - 1;
    var failed = 0;
    while i < len(s) && failed == 0 {
        var value = 0;
        var digits = 0;
        while i < len(s) && failed == 0 && duration_is_digit(int_of(s[i])) {
            if digits == 9 {
                failed = 1;
            } else {
                value = value * 10 + (int_of(s[i]) - 48);
                digits = digits + 1;
                i = i + 1;
            }
        }
        if failed == 0 {
            if digits == 0 {
                failed = 1;
            } else if i >= len(s) {
                failed = 1;
            }
        }
        if failed == 0 {
            let rank = duration_unit_rank(int_of(s[i]));
            if rank < 0 || rank <= last_rank {
                failed = 1;
            } else {
                last_rank = rank;
                total = total + value * duration_unit_seconds(rank);
                i = i + 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if failed == 1 {
        return result.Result::Err("not a duration");
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(total);
}

edition 7;
import std.result;
import std.buffer;

fn duration_is_digit(c: int) -> [] bool {
    return c >= 48 && c <= 57;
}

fn duration_unit_rank(c: int) -> [] int {
    if c == 119 { return 0; }
    if c == 100 { return 1; }
    if c == 104 { return 2; }
    if c == 109 { return 3; }
    if c == 115 { return 4; }
    return 0 - 1;
}

fn duration_unit_seconds(rank: int) -> [] int {
    if rank == 0 { return 604800; }
    if rank == 1 { return 86400; }
    if rank == 2 { return 3600; }
    if rank == 3 { return 60; }
    return 1;
}

fn duration_unit_letter(rank: int) -> [] int {
    if rank == 0 { return 119; }
    if rank == 1 { return 100; }
    if rank == 2 { return 104; }
    if rank == 3 { return 109; }
    return 115;
}

fn duration_parse[&r](s: &r [byte]) -> [] result.Result[int, &static [byte]] {
    if len(s) == 0 {
        return result.Result::Err("empty duration");
    }
    var i = 0;
    var total = 0;
    var last_rank = 0 - 1;
    var failed = 0;
    while i < len(s) && failed == 0 {
        var value = 0;
        var digits = 0;
        while i < len(s) && failed == 0 && duration_is_digit(int_of(s[i])) {
            if digits == 9 {
                failed = 1;
            } else {
                value = value * 10 + (int_of(s[i]) - 48);
                digits = digits + 1;
                i = i + 1;
            }
        }
        if failed == 0 {
            if digits == 0 {
                failed = 1;
            } else if i >= len(s) {
                failed = 1;
            }
        }
        if failed == 0 {
            let rank = duration_unit_rank(int_of(s[i]));
            if rank < 0 || rank <= last_rank {
                failed = 1;
            } else {
                last_rank = rank;
                total = total + value * duration_unit_seconds(rank);
                i = i + 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if failed == 1 {
        return result.Result::Err("not a duration");
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(total);
}

fn duration_format[&h](heap: &!h Heap, seconds: int) -> [heap] result.Result[buffer.Buffer, &static [byte]] {
    if seconds < 0 {
        return result.Result::Err("negative duration");
    }
    if seconds == 0 {
        var zero = buffer.empty(heap, 8);
        zero = buffer.append(heap, zero, "0s");
        return result.Result::Ok(zero);
    }
    var out = buffer.empty(heap, 32);
    var rest = seconds;
    var rank = 0;
    while rank < 5 {
        let unit = duration_unit_seconds(rank);
        let n = rest / unit;
        if n > 0 {
            out = buffer.push_nat(heap, out, n);
            out = buffer.push(heap, out, byte_of(duration_unit_letter(rank)));
            rest = rest - n * unit;
        }
        rank = rank + 1;
    }
    return result.Result::Ok(out);
}
